preconditions.description: The number of intersections n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each shortcut a_i is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The shortcuts are non-decreasing, i.e., a_i <= a_{i+1} for all i < n-1.

postconditions.description: The output list m contains exactly n elements.
The minimum energy to reach intersection 1 is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(m[i] == min(m[j] + abs(i - j) for j in range(i)) or m[i] == m[j] + 1 for i in range(1, n) for j in range(i) if a[j] == i)
postconditions.description: The minimum energy to reach intersection i is either the minimum energy to reach any previous intersection j plus the energy cost of moving from j to i, or the minimum energy to reach a previous intersection j plus 1 if there is a shortcut from j to i.
